rows.grounds: compound sāmyāntara-rasa-āsvāda-mela in locative singular; final -e undergoes sandhi with following initial ā to yield -āv; refers to the union described in the preceding context
from ātman and anu-bhū; denotes direct experiential realization of the self

items.question: In what union of tasting the inner essence of equality is the self directly experienced?
premises: A union characterized by tasting the inner essence of equality is present.
Within this union the self becomes the object of direct experience.
Such experience is not described as occurring outside this union.
items.inference: Direct experience of the self arises in the union of tasting the inner essence of equality.
uncertainties: The precise nuance of mela (union, meeting, or melāpa) is inferred from context and tradition.
items.plain_english: In that union of tasting the inner essence of equality, the Self is directly experienced.
